rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" autoreconf -vfi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls \ --disable-bash-completion \ --disable-use-tty-group \ --disable-makeinstall-chown \ --disable-makeinstall-setuid
# During the first phase of package builds during bootstrapping, the build # system finds /tools/include/ncurses and adds /tools/include to the header # search path even when the prefix has been set to /usr. To work around that # we fix up all files with /tools/include inside before running the build.
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ] && [ -d /tools/include/ncurses ]; then sed -i "s@/tools/include@/usr/include@g" $( grep -r -l -F "/tools/include" * | sort -u ) fi
rules.build:
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.libs" fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
rules.install:
install -d -m 0755 $AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/usr install -d -m 0755 $AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/usr/bin install -d -m 0755 $AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/usr/sbin install -d -m 0755 $AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/usr/lib
ln -sf usr/bin "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/bin" ln -sf usr/sbin "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sbin"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/bin" rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sbin"
